Steps: As Creator, add a new member.
Expected Result: Member is added to the group.

Steps: As Creator, remove a member whose balance with the group is $0.
As Creator, try to remove a member who has an unpaid balance.
Expected Result: Blocked — can't remove a member with an outstanding balance.

Steps: As a non-creator, open the Members tab.
Expected Result: Add/remove/rename controls are hidden; a read-only note is shown instead.

Steps: As Creator, delete the group (even with unpaid balances present).
Expected Result: Group and all its data are removed for every member, regardless of unpaid balances.
